shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.remoteNote: Extra fee, also on free-shipping orders

fallbackFaqs.question: How long does shipping take?
fallbackFaqs.answer: Orders paid before 2 PM (KST) on weekdays ship the same day and usually arrive in 1–2 days.

fallbackFaqs.question: Can I exchange for another size?
fallbackFaqs.answer: Yes. Unworn items can be exchanged once for free within 7 days of delivery.

fallbackFaqs.question: Do you ship to Jeju and remote islands?
fallbackFaqs.answer: Yes. An extra shipping fee applies depending on the area.

fallbackFaqs.question: When will international shipping open?
fallbackFaqs.answer: We plan to open international shipping in 2027.
